snippet.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2837690/Dungeons__Dragons_Long_Rest_Tavern/
Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern was revealed during the Future Games Show at gamescom. It's a fantasy life simulator where you cater for heroes in a cosy tavern, and it's coming to PC in early 2027.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
